hint.username: English letters, digits and . _ - only; 3–32 characters. Example: dr.ahmad
hint.password: At least 8 characters. Mixing letters and digits is safer.
hint.displayName: The name shown in the app and reports, e.g. “Dr. Ahmad”.
hint.role: The role decides which parts of the app this user can open.
hint.clinicName: The name on your clinic's sign and receipts.
hint.calendar: Dates across the app are shown in this calendar.
hint.theme: The clinic default; each user can change it from their menu.
hint.colors: Buttons and selected items use the clinic's main colour.
hint.timeout: Between 1 and 240 minutes. The screen locks when nobody uses the app.
hint.backupHour: The daily backup runs from this time on (while the app is open).
hint.keep: Between 1 and 365. Older backups are removed automatically.

rule.username_chars: No spaces or symbols; only English letters, digits and . _ -
rule.username_length: The username must be 3–32 characters long.
rule.username_format: Username: English letters, digits and . _ - only; 3–32 characters.
